findings.title: Require the gate process exit status even when output assertions pass
findings.detail: The instruction allows reading the gate exit code OR asserting its output text, despite the preceding rule requiring the gate own exit state. A gate can emit success text and subsequently exit nonzero; a passing text assertion can then recreate the false acceptance this paragraph is intended to prevent.
findings.suggested_fix: Require immediately capturing and checking the native gate exit code. Treat output assertions only as additional checks and explicitly state they cannot replace or override a nonzero exit. Keep the dated historical incident unchanged.
